- **Cliffside Port.** On the southern edge of Lake arden is a small warehouse where select goods are sent up to [[Public/World/Crestfall/Highreach/Highreach|Highreach]] via a manually operated elevator. routeEstimatesMethod.pace: 0.15 map widths of path per day
routeEstimatesMethod.calibration: The figure the DM gave: Highreach to Ardenville takes about a day, going around Lake Arden (straight line 0.101 map widths, about 1.5 times that around the lake).
routeEstimatesMethod.path: straight line x 1.2 unless a detour is stated
routeEstimatesMethod.rounding: nearest half day, never less than half a day
routeEstimatesMethod.conflict: The Fairfield note gives a hard ride of two days from Highreach. This method gives 1.5 days for ordinary travel on the same road, which is faster than a hard ride should be. One of the two needs changing; the estimate is left as computed so the conflict is visible.
routeEstimatesMethod.partyRule: These numbers never move the party. The DM decides how long the party travels. They are only the default for off-screen things (caravans, rumours) in later stages, and a hint shown to the DM.

Locals whisper that the guildmaster’s motives reach beyond celebration—especially after his recent clashes with certain adventurers.
